faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRDO RAC Chairperson recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRDO RAC Chairperson recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Chairperson post?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria require eminent retired or serving persons, including scientists, technologists, academicians, and civil servants, who hold the level of Secretary to the Government of India (Level 17).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chairperson position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Chairperson position is 65 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chairperson post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chairperson post will receive a salary of Rs. 2,25,000 per month, which corresponds to Level 17 of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DRDO RAC Chairperson recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Chairperson post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Search-cum-Selection Committee and subsequent approval from the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC).

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DRDO RAC, the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Chairperson post is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Chairperson posts by DRDO RAC is 158.
